body: A mysterious creature has been terrorizing residents of Valle de Juárez, Mexico, leaving locals frightened and some abandoning their homes. Witnesses describe a strange, hairless creature that walks on two legs and has an extraordinary ability to jump. Locals also blame the mysterious being for the disappearance and deaths of several farm animals, including chickens, pigeons, and rabbits. What could this creature be?
